name: Isekai Tensei Shitara Dai Mahoutsukai no Oshi ni Narimashita
original_name: 異世界転生したら大魔法使いの推しになりました
source:
The main character, who was an ordinary office worker, was gifted a powerful magic by God (?) and was reincarnated in another world.

The main character, who has become an 18-year-old village girl, activates a great amount of magic and faints in order to save a man who was about to be attacked by a beast in the forest. When she woke up, the man she helped suddenly confessed to her...!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7553]NovelGame[/url]]
